This Ethernet cable features 30AWG pure bare copper conductors housed within a slim, flat jacket, effectively reducing cable congestion, resisting tangling, and simplifying routing through cable management systems. The cable's unique FLEXboot™ design protects the plug's retaining clip while offering easy depressibility, facilitating faster and easier cable connections and changes.Delivering high performance with 550MHz of bandwidth, this stranded UTP (Unshielded Twisted Pair) cable ensures reliable and fast data transmission. The 50?m gold‑plated modular plugs provide superior corrosion resistance, ensuring clear signal transmission and durability over time.Monoprice Ethernet cables are crafted from 100% pure bare copper wire, meeting National Electrical Code® TIA‑568‑C.2 fire and safety standards and providing a dependable, compliant solution for your networking needs.
